stories.title: Prove exactly one queue consumer and one KV LIVE writer, feed non-authoritative
stories.scope: platform/wrangler.jsonc: exactly one queue consumer on nextgit-events, KV binding LIVE. platform/src/index.ts: exactly one env.LIVE.put site (recordEvent :685-688) and one env.LIVE.get site (readEvents :680-683); readEvents call sites limited to its definition, recordEvent and the GET /events route (:1151), so no write/identity path consults the feed. Live leg: the feed carries queue-origin cf.artifacts.* events, proving the consumer actually records.
stories.acceptance: wrangler.jsonc declares exactly one consumer on nextgit-events and one KV namespace; the worker has one KV LIVE put site (recordEvent) and one get site (readEvents), with readEvents consumed only by recordEvent and the GET /events route; the live feed contains cf.artifacts.* queue-consumer events. Evidence: `PASS one consumer, one KV writer, queue events recording live`.
